search_dir.description: The root directory from which the search begins.

file_name_regex.description: Regular expression pattern for matching file names.

content_regex.description: Regular expression pattern for matching text content within files.

match_case.description: Enable case-sensitive matching for file names and content.

use_dos_glob.description: Enable DOS-style glob matching (wildcards * and ?) for file names.

invert.description: Invert the search criteria to find files/content that do NOT match the patterns.

min_size_kb.description: Minimum file size in Kilobytes. 0 means no minimum.

max_size_kb.description: Maximum file size in Kilobytes. 0 means no maximum.

date_from.description: Search for files modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_to.description: Search for files modified on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

word_wrap.description: Enable word wrap in the results text pane.

show_toolbar.description: Show the toolbar in the application window.

show_status_bar.description: Show the status bar in the application window.

one_phase.description: Display content matches immediately as files are found (Phase 1 behavior).

text_editor.description: Path to the executable for the preferred text editor.

file_browser.description: Path to the executable for the preferred file browser.

extra_search_dirs.description: Additional directories to include in the search scope besides search_dir.
